races.name: Racing TV Free Trial For A Month Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
ZARA'S DREAM didn't shape with masses of promise in a bumper at Ballinrobe 3 months ago but she couldn't be in better hands and will surely up her game here. Plenty of these are unknown quantities but Dooks is a definite threat back hurdling.

  1. ZARA'S DREAM (IRE)
  2. DOOKS (IRE)
  3. MRS WRIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Botanica International Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
This has an open look to it with HEY NOW taken to pick up where he left off in the spring and supplement his Sligo win. Kentucky Beach's record fresh marks him out as a possible threat, along with Le Roi du Livet and The Besty Woman.

  1. HEY NOW
  2. KENTUCKY BEACH (FR)
  3. LE ROI DU LIVET (FR)

races.name: Start Your Free Trial On Racing TV Now Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Plenty of dead wood in this maiden and it could pay to side with the returning MCALLISTER, who made a promising start in this sphere at Punchestown this time last year and Paul Nolan's 5-y-o remains with potential. Walking Saint, Caprison and Lucky Valley look the main threats in that order.

  1. MCALLISTER (IRE)
  2. WALKING SAINT
  3. CAPRISON (IRE)

races.name: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
ARDERA GUN has been knocking at the door in recent starts so Eoin Doyle's 6-y-o earns the narrow vote to gain a breakthrough success at the expense of The Cobblers Wife, who got off the mark at Tramore on penultimate start and continued her run of good form over fences since. Allroadsleadtorome looks a potential improver now handicapping so he can fight out third with Hob's Angel.

  1. ARDERA GUN (IRE)
  2. THE COBBLERS WIFE (IRE)
  3. ALLROADSLEADTOROME

races.name: Michael Hickey Memorial Chase (Listed)
races.verdict:
THE BIG WESTERNER impressed with her jumping both starts over fences last season, opening her chase account in a Grade 2 mares novice at Limerick, and she remains capable of better still for her leading yard. She is taken to see off the challenge of The Enabler, who can go well as he drops back in distance, with Bossofthebrownies also considered.

  1. THE BIG WESTERNER (IRE)
  2. THE ENABLER (IRE)
  3. BOSSOFTHEBROWNIES (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
MODE AVION matched his hurdles form at the first attempt over fences when going close at Sligo in September and he sets the standard. A pair of the chasing debutants could be the main dangers, The Big Clubman appealing as the type to do better over fences and feared most, ahead of Fierce Handay.

  1. MODE AVION (FR)
  2. THE BIG CLUBMAN (IRE)
  3. FIERCE HANDAY (IRE)

races.name: Thank You To All Our Sponsors & Supporters In 2026 (C & G) (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
HARTFORD will ultimately require a longer distance when tackling obstacles but there's no reason why he can't land this bumper first. Prince Malinas will also be plugging on, while better was clearly expected from Ants Fantasy here in the summer.

  1. HARTFORD (IRE)
  2. PRINCE MALINAS (IRE)
  3. ANTS FANTASY (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Claiming Race
races.verdict:
APACHE OUTLAW hasn't been firing in turf handicaps but has a good chance on these terms on his first go in a claimer and back at the scene of his last 2 wins. The lightly-raced Saint Acclaim might be the danger.

  1. APACHE OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. SAINT ACCLAIM (IRE)
  3. GO ATHLETICO (FR)

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
THUMAMA GLORY and Always Magic are closely matched and were second and fourth in a similar event over C&D 7 weeks ago. They could be the pair to focus on, with Ado McGuinness's charge fancied to bounce back to form and come out on top. Monologue will be suited by 6f and should be on the premises also.

  1. THUMAMA GLORY (IRE)
  2. ALWAYS MAGIC
  3. MONOLOGUE (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap
races.verdict:
I BID YOU AJOU has dropped to his last winning mark and gets the vote with the cheekpieces back on returning to a venue where he usually goes well. Real Encounter, Navan winner Coincidental Glory and the thriving Caffu Zafeen are dangers.

  1. I BID YOU AJOU (FR)
  2. REAL ENCOUNTER (IRE)
  3. COINCIDENTAL GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Maiden
races.verdict:
A decidedly ordinary maiden with JUSTICIAR taken to get off the mark on the back of a good showing at Naas. The return to 7f will suit Otsana and she's a big danger. Newcomer Allez Magh Glas is from a family that has done well at Dundalk and she could play a part first time up.

  1. JUSTICIAR (IRE)
  2. OTSANA (IRE)
  3. ALLEZ MAGH GLAS (IRE)

races.name: Bet On The Best Night Out At Dundalk Stadium Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
LITTLEPACER is just the type her yard will continue to get more out of in low-grade nurseries and she can follow up her Gowran win. Closefield Beau looks the danger.

  1. LITTLEPACER (IRE)
  2. CLOSEFIELD BEAU (IRE)
  3. MUTAMARID LSK (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Christmas Party At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
IFF IN DOUBT has returned to form here of late and dropped 2 lb and now contesting a 0-60, can resume winning ways under an excellent apprentice. Dandyville showed all is not lost last time and could figure if building on that. Final Boss could have a race in him judged on his latest showing.

  1. IFF IN DOUBT (IRE)
  2. DANDYVILLE (IRE)
  3. FINAL BOSS (IRE)

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
ONE COOL COUNTY produced easily his best effort to date from a tricky position when fourth over 1m at Killarney 4 weeks ago and still relatively unexposed, he could be worth chancing to build on the promise of that effort. The Rock Factor is an intriguing runner returning from a break for his shrewd yard and is one to note. Star Mind and Dancing Steve are 2 in-form sorts also worth a look.

  1. ONE COOL COUNTY (IRE)
  2. THE ROCK FACTOR (IRE)
  3. STAR MIND

races.name: Veronika Walker: Moments That Matter Handicap
races.verdict:
From a handicapping perspective it's very hard to escape the claims of ALNOFOOR, who won a much better race than this at the Curragh on Sunday from out of the weights. Fear And Fast and Wen Moon may offer most resistance.

  1. ALNOFOOR
  2. FEAR AND FAST
  3. WEN MOON (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SEQUOIADENDRON's debut last week was full of promise and with above-average improvement envisaged, she may well progress beyond the standard set by True Heart. Wild Mary's Rose also promises to do better so needs considering.

  1. SEQUOIADENDRON (USA)
  2. TRUE HEART
  3. WILD MARY'S ROSE (GER)

races.name: Burton Roofing Merchants Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
FLYING MOONLIGHT not for the first time this season suggested a mark of 50 is well within his grasp when a close third over 1m at Ayr 4 weeks ago and with this track more suitable than when last tried over this trip, he's worth siding with to prove as much here. Easy Redcar winner Kartini looks a big danger under a penalty with Irish raider Grey Fable and Naturalia others fancied to be thereabouts.

  1. FLYING MOONLIGHT (IRE)
  2. KARTINI (IRE)
  3. GREY FABLE (IRE)

races.name: Burton Roofing Merchants Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This looks wide open, and with that in mind a chance is taken on IDYLLIC who has been in better heart than recent form figures would suggest and she's lurking on a handy mark if putting it all together. Gemini Man is proving consistent and merits respect along with top weight Alpine Sierra. West Sleekburn Lad completes the shortlist.

  1. IDYLLIC
  2. GEMINI MAN (IRE)
  3. ALPINE SIERRA (IRE)

races.name: Joe Fanning Fond Farewell Handicap
races.verdict:
Jim Goldie holds a strong hand here with AIGHEAR and Storm On Jura both arriving in top form, the former shading preference in search of a quick-fire hat-trick. Charlie Darling and Ned Broy are others making appeal, whilst last year's easy winner Quercus Robur would also enter the reckoning if ready to roll after 7 months off.

  1. AIGHEAR
  2. STORM ON JURA
  3. CHARLIE DARLING (FR)

races.name: Hibernian FC Emerald Club Handicap
races.verdict:
CAVALLO PAZZO has been revitalised by the application of a visor in recent weeks, really impressing with how he travelled when defying a 10 lb weight rise at Newcastle on Friday. Wisely turned out under a penalty, he looks a big player in his hat-trick bid, with Motawaared, Empirestateofmind, Ablon and Tolstoy other likely protagonists in an interesting affair.

  1. CAVALLO PAZZO (IRE)
  2. MOTAWAARED
  3. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE)

races.name: Nairns Oatcakes Handicap
races.verdict:
A 3-time winner in 2025 (including over C&D) THE RESDEV SCHOLAR quickly got back on track when second behind a revitalised veteran at Catterick 8 days ago and hailing from a stable in form, he looks to hold solid claims from a handy draw. Rhoscolyn benefited from the drop into a 0-80 when scoring at Leicester and merits respect under a 4-lb penalty despite a wide draw. Homestrait and Quest For Fun are others worth a second look.

  1. THE RESDEV SCHOLAR (IRE)
  2. RHOSCOLYN
  3. HOMESTRAIT (IRE)

races.name: Thank You For The Fun Gweedore Handicap
races.verdict:
WOBWOBWOB returned to winning ways in decisive fashion at Catterick last week and he remains on a handy mark under a penalty. He is fancied to follow up, with the consistent Vince le Prince the pick for second, ahead of Abduction.

  1. WOBWOBWOB (IRE)
  2. VINCE LE PRINCE
  3. ABDUCTION (FR)

races.name: EBF Desert Crown Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CHEVERE has improved with each of his 3 starts so far, only narrowly denied over this C&D on his latest outing, and could be ready to get off the mark this time round. Christmas Is Comin found some progress when third at Bath on his nursery debut and is feared most, while Apricot is worth a market check on debut.

  1. CHEVERE
  2. CHRISTMAS IS COMIN
  3. APRICOT (IRE)

races.name: Ladies Day 8th May On Sale Now Handicap
races.verdict:
SONIC SI completed a hat-trick between May and June, including over C&D, and was thriving before a 140-day absence. He's taken to resume winning ways on his return to a course where he's proven. Maharajas Express produced a career best when runner-up at Bath 6 days ago on softer going and is feared most, whilst Campenaerts ran well here last week.

  1. SONIC SI
  2. MAHARAJAS EXPRESS
  3. CAMPENAERTS

races.name: Racedays For 9 Pound At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SHAFFRON has conditions in her favour again and looks to be coming into her own as her stamina is tested further so is worth a chance to follow up now tackling 2m. Autumn's Breeze is respected if coming on for recent return and Personal Best is consistent so should be in the mix.

  1. SHAFFRON
  2. AUTUMN'S BREEZE (IRE)
  3. PERSONAL BEST

races.name: Experience Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
TEMPLE is bred to appreciate this longer trip and could be yet another to improve markedly for the switch to James Owen and could outstay Indhaar, who has potential but may not appreciate a slog, while Marquetry is another to take seriously upped in distance.

  1. TEMPLE
  2. INDHAAR
  3. MARQUETRY (IRE)

races.name: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TELE RED returned to form when a close second at Leicester 9 days ago and is on a winning mark over a trip and ground that suits him, so he's well worth chancing up against younger rivals here. Arbaawy has been in consistent form with successive runner-up efforts and a deserved first success shouldn't be far away, while Royal Poetry ran better than her latest result suggests.

  1. TELE RED
  2. ARBAAWY
  3. ROYAL POETRY (IRE)

races.name: Experience Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
BORJINA was unlucky not to open her handicap account when narrowly beaten over C&D and looks the type that should win a similar event before long. Royal Saxo shaped much better than the bare result at Listowel when denied a run and has to be of interest making the trip over from Ireland, while Beach Point is as reliable as they come and can fill the placings.

  1. BORJINA
  2. ROYAL SAXO (FR)
  3. BEACH POINT (IRE)

races.name: Watch Racing TV Now Handicap
races.verdict:
VENETIAN LION completed a hat-trick in September, including a win over C&D, and has been unlucky twice since so is taken to gain compensation at the expense of Tex, who ran well at the weekend, and the well-treated Talis Evolvere.

  1. VENETIAN LION
  2. TEX (FR)
  3. TALIS EVOLVERE (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
The finale can go the way of LAW OF DESIGN, who had been shaping up well this autumn prior to having excuses last time. He could be ready to get back to winning ways as he drops in grade, though Launch Time isn't taken lightly arriving on the back of a success at Ayr, while Just Queen High helps give Ian Williams a strong hand in the race.

  1. LAW OF DESIGN (IRE)
  2. LAUNCH TIME
  3. JUST QUEEN HIGH (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MYTHICAL COMPOSER is 3 lb below his last winning mark and could be ready to take advantage given how he shaped last time. Kitaro Kich and King of Ithaca are others to consider.

  1. MYTHICAL COMPOSER
  2. KITARO KICH (IRE)
  3. KING OF ITHACA

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
races.verdict:
PALLISER has gone very close since switching to handicaps and is narrowly preferred to the thriving Snooker McCrew. South Kensington may prove best of the others.

  1. PALLISER
  2. SNOOKER MCCREW
  3. SOUTH KENSINGTON (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider with the tentative vote going to RED CURRY, who wasn't beaten far despite a very slow start over C&D last month. Cloak of Power, Yamana and Marrwaa are all expected to leave their debut runs well behind in due course, so they head the dangers.

  1. RED CURRY
  2. CLOAK OF POWER (IRE)
  3. YAMANA

races.name: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This doesn't look as strong as the first division so LIGHT OF THE STARS might be good enough to make a winning start. El Ghanema is another well-connected newcomer, while You're Sensational is worth another chance to build on her debut promise.

  1. LIGHT OF THE STARS
  2. EL GHANEMA (IRE)
  3. YOU'RE SENSATIONAL

races.name: British EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
UNERRING was hooded for his debut and produced a promising effort when finishing third behind a pair that boasted prior experience at Southwell 4 weeks ago, coming from further back and staying on well. Looking sure to improve, not least now upped in trip, he could be the answer. Godolphin newcomer Silken Warrior makes obvious appeal, with Basics and Cabeceo 2 fellow debutants to note. Prince of Petra is another expected to step forward from his opening effort.

  1. UNERRING (IRE)
  2. SILKEN WARRIOR (IRE)
  3. BASICS (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
A good quality handicap. COLOMBIER looked seriously unlucky not to add to his tally in a Goodwood handicap back in July and with his latest run in France best overlooked (looked after when chance had gone) he looks worthy of siding with to prove his mark an exploitable one on all-weather debut. Valvano has an unexposed profile himself on this surface and is a threat, along with Force and Valour. Cosi Bello completes the dangers.

  1. COLOMBIER
  2. VALVANO (IRE)
  3. FORCE AND VALOUR (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint which can go the way of PERSIAN SPIRIT, who went backwards from her yard debut at Hamilton last time but Ed Bethell's filly can capitalise on this drop in grade. Miracleoftheandes has upped her game since switched to all-weather, so she's put forward as the main threat, with Phoenix Moon and Amelia's Joy taken to fight out third.

  1. PERSIAN SPIRIT (IRE)
  2. MIRACLEOFTHEANDES (IRE)
  3. PHOENIX MOON (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict:
Having dropped back down to his last winning mark, INVINCIBLE SPEED ran well when fourth over this C&D in July and the race has produced several winners since. He is taken to add to his tally at the chief expense of Monsieur Patat. The Coffee Pod isn't easy to win with but is expected to be on the premises again.

  1. INVINCIBLE SPEED (IRE)
  2. MONSIEUR PATAT
  3. THE COFFEE POD (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
ATATURK was collared only in the dying strides at Leicester 3 weeks ago so holds obvious claims off a similar mark. Foinix arguably should have won at Brighton last time so is another to consider, while Pseudonym is worth a second look on handicap bow.

  1. ATATURK
  2. FOINIX
  3. PSEUDONYM (IRE)

races.name: Lords Taverners Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GINGERBRED landed a gamble with a fair bit in hand starting out for this yard at Ffos Las on return and looks more than capable of defying a 7 lb rise. Roe And Co is refinding his form for his new yard and is a clear next best.

  1. GINGERBRED
  2. ROE AND CO (IRE)
  3. ANNIE EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RED ACRES MAX made a bright start to his career in bumpers, getting off the mark at the second attempt with something in hand at Carlisle, and appeals as one to keep on the right side as he goes over hurdles. He gets the vote ahead of New Rules, whose yard enjoy plenty of success with hurdling debutants, while Pitch And Toss is another to consider.

  1. RED ACRES MAX (IRE)
  2. NEW RULES (IRE)
  3. PITCH AND TOSS (IRE)

races.name: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Highly likely that this will be dominated by bumper winners ORDER ON TIME and St James's Finest. Both looked useful last season with the former arguably slightly more impressive in victory, so he's marginally preferred. Moonrise Monarch also represents a successful yard so needs considering.

  1. ORDER ON TIME (IRE)
  2. ST JAMES'S FINEST (IRE)
  3. MOONRISE MONARCH

races.name: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Those with form under Rules do not set an exacting standard so A SIGHT TO SEA, who won his point and is sure to be well prepared for this, looks the way to go. Jerry The Dreamer and The Lightmaker are also of some interest.

  1. A SIGHT TO SEA (IRE)
  2. JERRY THE DREAMER (IRE)
  3. THE LIGHTMAKER (IRE)

races.name: Lysaght Cup Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RULA BULA failed to kick on after her winning comeback last season, but she's built for chasing and is taken to progress this time after an encouraging debut in this sphere at Uttoxeter. Desertmore News also made a promising start to his chase career at Ffos Las so is feared most.

  1. RULA BULA (IRE)
  2. DESERTMORE NEWS (IRE)
  3. TOUR OVALIE (FR)

races.name: DragonBet Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A few in with a squeak but MR MCWHINNY has won 4 of his last 5 starts in this discipline and having run well when finding one too strong over hurdles last month, Tom Ellis' 8-y-o can quickly regain the winning thread back chasing. Two To Tango is proving consistent this season, so heads up the opposition, with last-time-out winner Rangatira Jack rounding off the shortlist on return.

  1. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)
  2. TWO TO TANGO
  3. RANGATIRA JACK

races.name: Floyds Turfcare & Weed Solutions Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CORNER FORWARD wasn't seen to best effect sent handicapping when third at Ffos Las in April, so he is worth another chance with this longer trip promising to suit on his return. The main danger could be I Heard A Rumour, who remains with potential also making her second handicap start, with V Power completing the shortlist.

  1. CORNER FORWARD (IRE)
  2. I HEARD A RUMOUR (IRE)
  3. V POWER

races.name: Dunraven Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Often one of the more informative bumpers held at this stage of the season. DON'T PANIC, Mirage d'Ainay and Smoke And Fire are 3 of the more obvious sorts before betting clues.

  1. DON'T PANIC
  2. MIRAGE D'AINAY (FR)
  3. SMOKE AND FIRE (IRE)

races.name: Gallop TV Open Maiden
races.verdict:
J LORDI has been running well here and can get off the mark. Tp Thunderchild could figure, while Declare The Spot may also be in the mix.

  1. J LORDI (SAF)
  2. TP THUNDERCHILD (SAF)
  3. DECLARE THE SPOT (SAF)

races.name: Live It. Love It. Own It. www.racecoast.co.za Open Maiden
races.verdict:
ALL ABOUT ME looks marginally the pick. Owner Of Creation should be involved at the business end as well, while America First is also in the running for some place money at least.

  1. ALL ABOUT ME (SAF)
  2. OWNER OF CREATION (SAF)
  3. AMERICA FIRST (SAF)

races.name: Join The Race Coast Turf Club Today! Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
PENNYS CHOICE can win again. Showgirl will probably give the selection most to think about, while Trois Trois Quatre is another with place prospects.

  1. PENNYS CHOICE (SAF)
  2. SHOWGIRL (SAF)
  3. TROIS TROIS QUATRE (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Colossus Pools Exclusive On www.tote.co.za Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
HAT MONTERA gets the vote. Pinot Grigio appeals most among the rest, while World Of Our Own also requires consideration.

  1. HAT MONTERA (SAF)
  2. PINOT GRIGIO (SAF)
  3. WORLD OF OUR OWN (SAF)

races.name: Online Form Guide www.galloptv.co.za Progress Plate
races.verdict:
FIRE CHIEF is the one to beat. Clair De Lune makes most appeal among the rest, while Tiger Cody may grab a bit of place money.

  1. FIRE CHIEF (SAF)
  2. CLAIR DE LUNE (SAF)
  3. TIGER CODY (SAF)

races.name: Tote For The Win Foundation Stakes
races.verdict:
ANGEL'S OASIS looks the way to go. Music Is Life is a big danger, while Navajo Dancer also demands a closer look.

  1. ANGEL'S OASIS (SAF)
  2. MUSIC IS LIFE (SAF)
  3. NAVAJO DANCER (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Power Pick Foundation Stakes
races.verdict:
SANBEENEE could be the way to go. Arctic Fury may be the one for second, while Full Monty looks best of the remainder.

  1. SANBEENEE (SAF)
  2. ARCTIC FURY (SAF)
  3. FULL MONTY (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Fm 74 Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
PREDATOR'S CROWN is in a good run of form and has leading claims. Red Hot Miss is a solid alternative, while What A Classic may be the one for third.

  1. PREDATOR'S CROWN (SAF)
  2. RED HOT MISS (SAF)
  3. WHAT A CLASSIC (SAF)

races.name: Prix Miguel Et Christophe Clement Handicap
Prix De La Rianderie Claiming Stakes
Prix De La Rue Fouquet Lelong Handicap
Prix De La Region Pays De Loire - Attele
